description: Structured changes supported by the original contract and amendment.

sections_changed.description: Identifiers of substantively modified or added sections, explicitly deleted sections, or original sections conclusively absent from a clearly complete revised version. Omission from a partial or uncertain-scope amendment is not sufficient evidence of deletion. Renumbering alone is not a substantive change.

topics_touched.description: Legal or commercial topics affected by the changes.
topics_touched.title: Topics Touched

summary_of_the_change.description: Evidence-based summary of additions, deletions, and modifications, including relevant previous and new values.
